articles.summary: WALTHAM, Mass. – May 15, 2024 – Upstream Bio, Inc., a clinical-stage company focused on the development of verekitug, a potential first-in-class antagonist of the Thymic Stromal Lymphopoietin (TSLP) receptor that may deliver best-in-class efficacy for people with severe asthma and related diseases, today announced an upcoming presentation featuring clinical data from its dose-ranging study […]
articles.title: Upstream Bio to Present Results from a Dose Ranging Study of Verekitug (UPB-101) in Adults with Asthma at the American Thoracic Society (ATS) International Conference

articles.summary: – In a multiple-ascending dose (MAD) study in patients with asthma, up to 54% reduction in fractional exhaled nitric oxide concentration (FENO) was observed with administration of verekitug, with treatment effects sustained up to 24 weeks after last dose – – Verekitug displayed a favorable safety and tolerability profile without evidence of clinically meaningful immunogenicity […]
articles.title: Upstream Bio Presents Results from a Dose Ranging Study of Verekitug (UPB-101) in Adults with Asthma at the American Thoracic Society International Conference
